criteria: All test cases pass on revision (Code Score >= 90)
Candidate explanation aligns closely with the ground-truth ideal reasoning (Reasoning Score >= 85)
Candidate accurately identifies the specific logical or algorithmic defect and explains why the fix resolves it without guessing
STRONG_HIRE.recruiter_takeaway: Exceptional problem-solving depth. Candidate understands system mechanics, not just surface-level syntax.

criteria: All test cases pass on revision (Code Score >= 80)
Candidate explanation identifies the general root cause but may lack architectural precision or omit subtle edge cases (Reasoning Score >= 65)
Demonstrates solid working comprehension with minor gaps
HIRE.recruiter_takeaway: Competent engineer who can debug and ship functional fixes with sound intuition.

criteria: Revised code passes most or all tests, BUT explanation reveals significant misconceptions or cargo-cult fixes (Reasoning Score < 60)
OR Candidate has sound theoretical reasoning but failed to implement a fully working revision (Code Score < 70)
LEAN_NO_HIRE.recruiter_takeaway: Inconsistent debugging ability. Risk of trial-and-error programming without deep comprehension.

criteria: Revised code still fails critical tests (Code Score < 50)
Explanation is missing, off-target, or demonstrates fundamental lack of comprehension of the failure mechanism
NO_HIRE.recruiter_takeaway: Did not demonstrate required debugging and code comprehension standards.
